title: 1997 AHSME Problem 4
statement: If \(a\) is \(50\%\) larger than \(c,\) and \(b\) is \(25\%\) larger than \(c,\) then \(a\) is what percent larger than \(b?\)

solutions.text: We have \(a=1.5c\) and \(b=1.25c.\) Thus \(\frac{a}{b}=\frac{1.5}{1.25}=1.2,\) so \(a\) is \(20\%\) larger than \(b.\) The correct answer is A.
hints: Write both \(a\) and \(b\) as multiples of \(c\)
The requested percentage uses \(b\), not \(c\), as its base
